scope: Original material initialization incl. HSV/gamma conversion and level overrides. Linux libc imports; no game startup or GPU rendering.

scatter.ordering: 30 opaque surfaces then 29 decal surfaces, definition order
scatter.vertexRule: scan up to 4 slots, stop on ID 0 or weight >= stopWeight; include iff weight > minimumWeight
scatter.triangleRule: union vertex masks; lowest ordinal remains opaque, remaining bits shift by materialCount-1
scatter.indices: stable input triangle order in each surface; counts-only call supported

skirt.materialRule: whole skirt drawn once per nonzero material ID present in any vertex; ignores weight
